summary.intent: Work through a series of spec-conformance and bug-fix clusters as separate branches/PRs in the callisto repo, currently completing cluster 5a (config match prefixes, workspace: warnings, error.path in JSON errors, E114 for bad pre.json baselines).
summary.outcome: Cluster 4 was pushed and cluster 5a was implemented by a subagent with new tests, passing graph/cli suites, clippy and fmt (except 3 network-dependent e2e tests); the assistant then committed it signed. Five earlier branches are pushed with PR bodies written but no PRs opened, pending PR-bot approval.

repo: Config `[[package]]`/`[[package-set]]` `match` patterns accept only cargo/npm/pypi prefixes (Ecosystem::CANONICAL); other prefixes give E317, while other callers keep using the broader `require_qualified`.
Repo has a 'sibling rule': when fixing a defect, sweep sibling variants with the same defect (applied to error.path across Init*, Artifact*, ParseToml, etc.).
Changesets live in `.changeset/` and are created via `callisto-cli add --package cargo/callisto-cli:patch --summary ...`.
`just workflow-contracts` is a validation gate for workflow changes.
Commits are signed; PRs require PR-bot approval from the user before opening.
Errors wrapping another error (Manifest, Locate, Vcs) still return null for error.path.
pre.json parse failures: InvalidInitialVersion maps to E114 (GraphError::PreJson), other parse failures remain E212.

code.finding: Added ConfigError::require_canonical_ecosystem sharing a private helper with require_qualified, plus GraphError::path() and ConfigError::path().
build_edges now warns for any unresolved WorkspaceProtocol dependency (not only relative form), avoiding duplicate warnings when the name exists in another ecosystem.
New parse_existing_pre_json used by pre enter (resume) and pre exit to map invalid baseline versions to E114.

workflow: Delegating each cluster to a subagent in its own worktree/branch from main keeps fixes isolated per PR.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instructions; verify before acting.
Sandbox blocks network and uv cache, causing unrelated e2e test failures (pnpm/uv native resolution, polyglot lifecycle).

friction: 3 callisto-cli e2e tests fail in sandbox due to network/uv cache restrictions, unrelated to the changes.
PRs for five pushed branches are blocked awaiting the user's PR-bot approval.
cargo fmt needed a pass after the subagent's edits.
open_items: Cluster 5b (dual-manifest cascade) and cluster 6 (missing tests) still to do.
Open PRs for the pushed branches once PR-bot approval is given.
The cross-ecosystem name match plus workspace: reference 'no second warning' guard is untested.
Decide whether error.path broadening should be narrowed to Init variants only.
Wrapped-path errors (Manifest, Locate, Vcs) still return null error.path.
